_about: Business glossary. Definitions explain what a term means in this app and its limits; they hold no figures. Status says whether the business owner has signed the definition.

terms.definition: The amount billed for a service line before any payment or adjustment.
terms.basis: Date of service in the claim-financials and claim-volume reports.
terms.limits: Raw sums only. No rate or percentage is derived from charges until the owner signs the definition.

terms.definition: Money posted from an insurance payer against a claim.
terms.limits: Insurance and patient payments are always reported separately. The source has two payment columns that do not agree on a sample, so totals are draft until the owner confirms which is right.

terms.definition: Money posted from the patient or guarantor.
terms.limits: Reported separately from insurance payments.

terms.definition: In this app, insurance payments plus patient payments posted in the period.
terms.limits: 'Revenue' is not one metric. Until finance agrees a house definition, this app shows payments received and says so. No collection rate is calculated.

terms.definition: A change to what is owed on a claim that is not a payment, such as a contractual write-down or a manual write-off.
terms.basis: Raw sums by practice or month in the charges reports.
terms.limits: Contractual and manual adjustments are not classified further, and a negative amount is not assumed to be a refund.

terms.definition: The part of a charge that a payer contract says will not be paid.
terms.limits: Not reported on its own in this app.

terms.definition: A balance removed from the books as uncollectable.
terms.limits: Not separated from other adjustments, so a write-off figure cannot be given on its own.

terms.definition: A claim the payer refused to pay.
terms.limits: The source only records Accepted and Rejected status entries, so this app counts claims with a status entry. It cannot give denied dollars: a claim's open balance is not treated as denied money.

terms.definition: A claim returned by a payer or clearinghouse before it was processed, usually for a data error.
terms.limits: Counted as claims, never as dollars.

terms.definition: A request for payment sent to a payer for one or more service lines.
terms.basis: Unique claim numbers are counted once however many lines they have.
terms.limits: Claim counts and line counts are different figures.

terms.definition: Where a claim stands with the payer, for example accepted or rejected, with a reason.
terms.limits: Only the statuses the source records are available.

terms.definition: Open balances where an insurance payer is the party that owes.
terms.basis: A balance on one day (as of the latest load), grouped by how long it has been open.
terms.limits: The source keeps no history, so month-over-month A/R movement cannot be calculated. Comparing two dates shows the balance on each day only.

terms.definition: Open balances where the patient is the party that owes.
terms.basis: One account at a time, by account number.
terms.limits: There is no aggregate patient A/R report yet; the balance source was empty when last checked.

terms.definition: What is still owed on claims or accounts, by insurance payers or by patients.
terms.limits: Ask for insurance A/R or a single patient account; the two are different reports.

terms.definition: Money received but not yet matched to a claim or charge.
terms.basis: Not separated in the available reports.
terms.limits: It must stay separate from allocated payments; no report isolates it yet.

terms.definition: Money returned to a payer or patient.
terms.basis: Not separated in the available reports.
terms.limits: A negative payment is not automatically a refund; classification rules are not agreed.

terms.definition: A transaction posted to undo or correct an earlier one.
terms.basis: Not separated in the available reports.
terms.limits: Needs validated classification rules before it can be reported.

terms.definition: The day the care was given.
terms.basis: Used for charges and claim volume.
terms.limits: Different from the posting date, so charges and payments for the same period do not line up claim by claim.

terms.definition: The day a payment or adjustment was recorded in the system.
terms.limits: Can be days after the payment date or deposit date.

terms.definition: The day money reached the bank.
terms.basis: Available as a date basis for some payment reports.
terms.limits: Not the default; the answer states which date basis it used.

terms.definition: The day a claim was first sent to the payer.
terms.basis: Used for submissions and days to bill.
terms.limits: Days to bill needs a source table that is empty at the moment.

terms.definition: Days from the date of service to the first claim submission.
terms.basis: Claims first submitted in the period.
terms.limits: The source table had no rows when last checked, so no figure can be given.

terms.definition: Open A/R divided by average daily charges over a trailing window.
terms.limits: Not calculated. The owner has not signed the definition (DEC-09), so no value is given.

terms.definition: Payments divided by (charges minus contractual adjustments).
terms.limits: Not calculated until the owner signs the definition (DEC-09).

terms.definition: The share of claims accepted on first submission without correction.
terms.limits: Not calculated until the owner signs the definition (DEC-10).

terms.definition: Denied claims divided by claims adjudicated.
terms.limits: Not calculated: the source only has Accepted and Rejected entries, so denials cannot be measured cleanly (DEC-09).
